details: FHSA annual room $8,000 plus up to $8,000 carryforward; $40,000 lifetime combined contributions/transfers. HBP cap $60,000.
limitations: Complex excess FHSA repairs, withdrawal year exemptions and RRSP qualification excluded.

details: A new FHSA starts with C$8,000 participation room; HBP withdrawal ceiling is C$60,000 subject to eligibility.
